question: Within a fixed scale, is the reconstruction cost of mis-set cell asymmetric (too-small cell = requesting more detail costs more than too-large), and does it lie above LR Nyquist (u>=1)?
origin: Exploratory CPU re-analysis of seen DIV2K 0837-0868 (claude-20261019-u-profile-v1) suggested asymmetry but confounded scale with direction. This run is the first within-scale test on cohorts never used for cell sweeps.
preprocessing: RGB center crop 240 HR /255; torch bicubic antialias align_corners=False to 240/s; LR clamp[0,1]; output raw unclipped
cell: cell = m * 2/240 (m=1 native). Equivalent scale s_eq = s/m. In training support iff 1<=s_eq<=4.
metric: MSE after shave 4 (232x232), split by non-DC Chebyshev FFT radius in u=2*s*r bins of width 0.25 up to u=s. Per bin store err(m), and a(m)=<T-P1, Pm-P1>, b(m)=|Pm-P1|^2.

definitions.C(m): pooled-over-images MSE(m) - MSE(1) within a group (model,seed,dataset,scale)
definitions.pair: (m, 1/m) with m in {1.1,1.25,1.3333,1.6,2.0}; usable only if both s/m and s*m in [1,4]

predictions_frozen_before_run.H1_location: For groups at scale 2,3,4 and every in-support m!=1 with |C(m)|>1e-7: share of sum_b |dMSE_b| lying in bins u>=1 is >=0.8. PASS if true for >=90% of (group,m).
predictions_frozen_before_run.H2_asymmetry: For every usable pair in scales 2 and 3: C(1/m) > C(m) (smaller cell costs more). PASS if >=80% of (group,pair) and median C(1/m)/max(C(m),1e-9) >= 2. Reported per model.
predictions_frozen_before_run.H3_secondary_theory: Descriptive: across u-bins, per-bin asymmetry log((dMSE_b(1/m)+eps)/(dMSE_b(m)+eps)) is larger where native per-bin recovery R_b=1-err_b(1)/|T|^2_b is lower (Spearman<0 in majority of groups). Not a gate.
predictions_frozen_before_run.reported_not_gated: argmin_m of MSE per group; x4 small-cell side and all x6 are out of training support and reported separately; per-image fraction for H2.

failures: All outcomes reported including failed gates; no change of bins, metrics, cohorts, or multipliers after seeing results; any code change gets a new version root.
compute: GPU inference only, single device with spare memory, no training; others' jobs not touched.
